content.short: Backed Finance tokenizes real-world assets like stocks and ETFs, bringing traditional finance to the blockchain.
content.description: Backed Finance is a Real World Asset (RWA) platform that issues "bTokens"—ERC-20 tokens representing ownership of traditional financial assets like Tesla and Google stocks, ETFs, and U.S. Treasury bonds. For every token minted, Backed purchases the underlying asset on a 1-to-1 basis and holds it with a regulated custodian, ensuring full collateralization. By bringing these assets on-chain, Backed allows users to gain exposure to traditional markets and utilize tokenized equities as collateral in DeFi. This bridge enhances capital efficiency and provides a broader range of investment options, offering secure and transparent infrastructure for the RWA sector.
